data.unit: GSS-nominated work establishment record; duplicate nominations may represent the same establishment
data.source_notes: Use supplied dictionary and source description. V1 identifies records; it is not established as a unique establishment cluster ID. V3=0 marks copied interviews.

sample_steps.rule: Load the public establishment interview file, preserving source codes and routing flags. No article instruction selects telephone over mail or imposes employment/age thresholds.

Resolve duplicated-nomination policy before constructing standard scores: retain all source records or restrict V3!=0. Neither policy is documented by the article; A01. Preserve original row identity.

Create routed occupation and decision blocks, recode documented nonresponse separately from structural skips, and resolve item-level completeness and skip policies A03–A05. Do not use listwise deletion of every source column because alternate routes are structurally blank.

Construct outcomes, HRM practices and controls per variable definitions after resolving coding axes. Choose and record the standardization reference population before any z scores; perform logarithms before z scores where specified. Map industry codes without treating Census as SIC.

Organizational-performance population includes for-profit and nonprofit establishments. Market-performance population is profit-making in prose (V8=1); Table 1 instead says publicly held (V8=1 and V9=4). Keep A02 open. Do not require market items for organizational models.

Apply the chosen missingness/sample policy to constructed variables needed by each equation. Common within-outcome complete cases across all practices versus equation-specific complete cases is unresolved (A04). Lock the same sample for each nested F comparison and construct interaction terms. No stopping rule based on an expected sample count is permitted.

variables.item_coding: For valid codes 1–4 use 5−x, giving worse=1 through much better=4. Q.75a–g: quality, new products, attraction, retention, customer satisfaction, management relations, employee relations.
variables.missing_value_rule: 7,8,9 and system missing are missing; item completeness rule unresolved.
variables.transformation: Reverse code; combine seven items
variables.scale_construction: Arithmetic mean is closest-described interpretation of the stated scale, but aggregation operator is not explicitly named.
variables.ambiguities: Minimum valid items, equal weighting and complete versus available-item mean are not specified. A04.

variables.item_coding: For valid codes 1–4 use 5−x. Q.76a–d: marketing, sales growth, profitability, market share.
variables.missing_value_rule: 7,8,9 and system missing are missing. Outside the eligible universe is structurally missing, never a low performance value.
variables.transformation: Reverse code; combine four items
variables.scale_construction: Arithmetic mean is provisional; exact operator not explicit.
variables.ambiguities: Profit-making universe in prose conflicts with publicly held only in Table 1 footnote a (D1 p10); A02. Minimum valid items A04.

variables.item_coding: Applications per opening for CORE, GSS and managers; V50/V85/V119 identify outside-hiring skips, V79/V114 and occupational variables help distinguish same-occupation routes.
variables.missing_value_rule: 998/999 and 997 are missing. 995 is a substantive category declared missing by the release; no numerical value is justified. Structural skips and zero counts require explicit branches.
variables.transformation: Log each application count, standardize each logged item, then average.
variables.scale_construction: Mean of three item z scores.
variables.ambiguities: Log base, zero handling, code 995 (large number of applications), same-occupation reuse, z-score reference sample and denominator not specified. A03,A05,A07,A08.

variables.item_coding: V145: yes=1/no=2 in source; orient yes higher, but original recoding not documented (0/1 or 1/2 branches). V172 valid 1–3 becomes 4−x; V157 is number trained.
variables.missing_value_rule: V145/V172 8,9 and V157 99998,99999 missing; V172=4 outside the described effectiveness range. Do not infer effectiveness for no-training establishments.
variables.transformation: Text: standardize the three measures and average. Table 1 footnote b: standard scores of logged values for all three.
variables.scale_construction: Mean of three item z scores after selected transformations.
variables.ambiguities: Log all items versus unlogged standardization unresolved. Binary zero cannot be logged. No-training effectiveness and count skips, V172=4 varies/depends, V157=99996 top code require decisions. A05,A06,A08,A16.

variables.item_coding: Job performance importance for managers, CORE and GSS. Source 1=very important,2=somewhat,3=not; orient higher importance with 4−x.
variables.missing_value_rule: 7 where used, 8,9 and system missing; structural same-occupation routing unresolved.
variables.transformation: Reverse coding; aggregate three items
variables.scale_construction: Equal-item arithmetic mean is provisional; operator not stated.

variables.transformation: Indicator

variables.item_coding: For each of eight decisions choose Q.72a (V271–V278) when V17=1, or Q.72b (V279–V286) when V17=2. These are routed versions, not sixteen separate items. Source codes: 1 head,2 below,3 above/larger organization,4 head+below,5 head+above,6 depends.

variables.ambiguities: Cannot implement the stated five-point ordering uniquely from the supplied codes. Do not use source numeric order as decentralization. CEO meaning (establishment versus parent) and mixed responses unresolved. A09.

variables.item_coding: Five yes/no items: CORE internal fill and promotion above CORE, GSS internal fill and promotion, managerial internal fill. Valid source 1=yes,2=no becomes 3−x (yes=2,no=1).
variables.missing_value_rule: 8,9 and system missing; distinguish absence of an occupation from same-occupation skips.
variables.transformation: Reverse coding
variables.ambiguities: Aggregation/minimum item count, occupational reuse or omission unresolved. A03,A04.

variables.item_coding: Count includes lowest and highest levels. Code 96 denotes 100 levels or more, not literally 96.
variables.missing_value_rule: 98,99 and system missing; nonpositive logarithm undefined.
variables.transformation: Log count per Table 1 footnote c; prose simply describes count.
variables.ambiguities: Log base and handling nonpositive counts/top code unresolved; raw-count branch reflects prose only. A10,A16.

variables.item_coding: Source 1=for-profit,2=nonprofit. Prose calls this a dummy; analysis origin uses I(V8=2).

variables.item_coding: Total full-time plus part-time establishment employment; raw total V23+V32 or release-assigned NEWTOTAL. Do not use larger-organization V339 as the same unit.
variables.missing_value_rule: V23/V32/NEWFULL/NEWPART 99998,99999 missing; NEWTOTAL no declared codes. Never set unknown employment to zero.
variables.transformation: Natural logarithm of total employment
variables.ambiguities: Article does not specify raw versus assigned counts, missing part-time counts or zero treatment. A12.

variables.item_coding: Age=1991−V16, establishment founding year.
variables.missing_value_rule: 9998,9999 and system missing; zero/negative age cannot enter ordinary log.
variables.transformation: Log age in regression row labels; age in years in prose. Natural log is provisional by analogy to employment, not expressly stated.
variables.ambiguities: Level versus log contradiction; zero-age treatment and log base unresolved. A10.

variables.item_coding: Numerator V115 for distinct manager occupation. V114=3 indicates no managers; same-as-CORE/GSS route may require corresponding V45/V80, but mapping is not specified. Denominator total employment as defined above.
variables.missing_value_rule: Count codes 99998/99999 missing; V114 8/9 missing. Routing-coded absence can justify zero only when explicitly no managers, not an unspecified skip.
variables.transformation: Prose says percentage: 100×manager count / total. Fraction versus percentage retained as scale branch.
variables.ambiguities: No explicit numerator, denominator or same-occupation rule; A03,A12,A13. Do not use printed descriptive values to select units.

variables.ambiguities: No unique implementation. Candidate sets {V220,V233} and {V220,V233,V300} are uncertain, neither established. No union-negotiations manager item appears in Q.61. A14.

inference.tail_rule: Table notes specify one-tailed tests. H1/H2 alternatives are positive. For nuisance controls and negative slopes no prespecified test direction is given; do not silently use absolute t for positive hypotheses. Report signed t and directional p, with test-direction ambiguity recorded.
inference.joint_tests: For M2/M3/M7/M8 compare against intercept + listed controls + industry effects on exactly the same rows: joint null is six HRM slopes zero. For M4/M5/M9/M10 compare against corresponding M2/M3/M7/M8: joint null is three interaction slopes zero. F uses its upper tail, not half a two-sided p. Report full-model F as well. Single-practice families have no one shared full-model statistic.

missingness: Neither item-level nor model-level missingness, imputation, sample restriction sequence, or duplicate handling is documented. Declared release missings are not sufficient for substantive coding; honor question wording and record chosen axes. No empirical target matching is an admissible resolution.
unresolved_items: A01 duplicate nominations; no original establishment grouping key identified.
A02 profit-making versus publicly held eligibility.
A03 occupational skips: reuse, available-item construction or exclusion; manager numerator routing.
A04 item completeness, mean versus other scale aggregation, model-common versus equation-specific cases.
A05 training no-use skips and exceptional category values.
A06 log versus raw training items; binary recode before log.
A07 staffing nonpositive counts, special large-application category, log base.
A08 standardization reference sample, timing and SD divisor.
A09 complete five-level decision-authority mapping unavailable.
A10 age level/log conflict; hierarchy log base and nonpositive handling.
A11 nonprofit/subsidiary coding and subsidiary construct scope.
A12 total employment raw versus release-assigned values and manager denominator.
A13 managers fraction versus percentage.
A14 union-pressure item set and construction not identifiable.
A15 competition coding and product/service neither category.
A16 top-coded training participation and hierarchy count treatment.
A17 SIC vintage/crosswalk, unmatched industries, reference category and effective dummy rank.
A18 centering of interactions.
A19 median reference and unreported threshold/spline/subgroup equations.
A20 weights and covariance correction; neither reported.
A21 exact estimator/software/default df convention not stated; OLS is a provisional linear-regression interpretation.
A22 control-tail direction and any multiplicity adjustment unspecified.
